lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of horizontally aligned, high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming a multi-row grid along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Transverse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to define a coordinate-like spatial grid across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher spatial density of smaller-scale high-luminance spots compared to the larger macro-blobs observed on the lateral flank.
